corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 6th-order ሽ in the Amharic converb ወግሽቶ (from ወገሸ, 'having been startled/spooked, it enters'), misread as 4th-order ሻ.
Canonical Ge'ez Gospel text (Matt 21:15) and printed glyphs read ወደቂቀኒ እንዘ ይጸርሑ ('and the children crying out'), where 1st-order ቀ was misread as ቆ and 2nd-order ሑ in ይጸርሑ was misread as ኑ.
